expectations.text: Proposes a specific, curiosity-driving subject line rather than a flat 'DeltaHack and Brannock Systems partnership'-style label
expectations.evidence: Subject: 'Hands-on feedback on your tracing agent from 500 student builders' is specific to Brannock's stated need (tracing-agent feedback) and frames value for the recipient instead of a flat partnership label. It is concrete and relevant, but it reads more like a value statement than a strong curiosity hook (no question or open loop), so it falls short of a full 5.
